sentences.text: Tequila -LRB- Spanish -RRB- is a regionally specific name for a distilled beverage made from the blue agave plant , primarily in the area surrounding the city of Tequila , 65 km northwest of Guadalajara , and in the highlands -LRB- Los Altos -RRB- of the central western Mexican state of Jalisco .	distilled beverage	distilled beverage	blue agave	Agave tequilana	Tequila	Tequila, Jalisco	Guadalajara	Guadalajara, Jalisco	Los Altos	Los Altos (Jalisco)	Mexican state	Mexican state	Jalisco	Jalisco

Although tequila is similar to mezcal , modern tequila differs somewhat in the method of its production , in the use of only blue agave plants , as well as in its regional specificity .	blue agave	Agave tequilana	mezcal	mezcal
Tequila is commonly served neat in Mexico and as a shot with salt and lime across the rest of the world .	Tequila	Tequila, Jalisco

The red volcanic soil in the surrounding region is particularly well suited to the growing of the blue agave , and more than 300 million of the plants are harvested there each year .	blue agave	Agave tequilana	volcanic	volcano
Agave grows differently depending on the region .
Blue agaves grown in the highlands Los Altos region are larger in size and sweeter in aroma and taste .	Los Altos	Los Altos (Jalisco)
Agaves harvested in the lowlands , on the other hand , have a more herbaceous fragrance and flavor .

Mexican laws state that tequila can only be produced in the state of Jalisco and limited municipalities in the states of Guanajuato , Michoacán , Nayarit , and Tamaulipas .	Jalisco	Jalisco	municipalities	Municipalities of Mexico	Guanajuato	Guanajuato	Michoacán	Michoacán	Nayarit	Nayarit	Tamaulipas	Tamaulipas
Tequila is recognized as a Mexican designation of origin product in more than 40 countries .	Tequila	Tequila, Jalisco

It is protected through NAFTA in Canada and the United States , through bilateral agreements with individual countries such as Japan and Israel , and has been a protected designation of origin product in the constituent countries of the European Union since 1997 .	NAFTA	NAFTA	protected designation of origin	protected designation of origin	European Union	European Union

Tequila is most often made at a 38 % alcohol content -LRB- 76 U.S. proof -RRB- for domestic consumption , but can be produced between 31 and 55 % alcohol content -LRB- 62 and 110 U.S. proof -RRB- .	Tequila	Tequila, Jalisco	U.S. proof	U.S. proof
Per U.S law , tequila must contain at least 40 % alcohol -LRB- 80 U.S. proof -RRB- to be sold in the United States .	U.S. proof	U.S. proof
